_comment: PostToolUse checks on Write/Edit/MultiEdit, scanning newly-written PowerShell content for the two costliest mistakes hit building the reference implementation this plugin generalizes from: components created without explicit solution targeting, and hand-built cascade configuration objects that can silently become parental-equivalent. Neither hook can (or needs to) guard calls that already go through Dataverse.psm1's own functions, which enforce both rules at the PowerShell language level (mandatory parameters, ValidateSet) - these hooks catch new code that bypasses those safe wrappers.

hooks.command: node -e "const path=require('node:path'); const root=process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; if(!root){console.error('PLUGIN_ROOT is not set'); process.exit(0);} require(path.resolve(root,'hooks','validate-solution-targeting.js'));"
